title: Platinum-supported catalysts on modified γ-Al2O3 carriers for enhanced NO oxidation in diesel exhaust aftertreatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13540-13547
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00070C, Paper
Open Access

Xin Dai, Jingfang Zhu, Dezhi Ren, Fei Yu, Shiying Chang, Yunkun Zhao
This study investigates the catalytic performance of platinum (Pt)-supported catalysts for nitric oxide (NO) oxidation in diesel vehicle exhaust aftertreatment systems, focusing on the effect of carrier modification.
